emma (people-ops): Quick pack of micro-templates for goal-setting & feedback — intended for managers and ICs. Use in OKR writeups, 1:1s, and peer feedback requests. TL;DR: 3-line goal + 2 metrics + 3 reflection bullets.

emma (people-ops): Manager 3-line goal template (drop-in):
```
Goal: Reduce inference cost per 1M tokens by 20% for our standard text-generation route.
Why it matters: Lowers unit cost and enables more generous rate limits for freemium users.
Success metrics: 1) -20% cost/token baseline; 2) p95 latency <= 220ms; 3) no regression in QA eval set (>95% pass).
```

emma (people-ops): IC 3-line goal template (short):
```
Goal: Implement KV cache improvements to cut token compute by 12% in long-context flows.
Measures: perf benchmark delta, PR review, rollout to 10% traffic.
Notes: link to benchmarks + migration checklist.
```

emma (people-ops): Self-review bullets (concise for reviews):
```
- What I shipped: one-line summary + link to PR/epic
- Impact: quant or qualitative outcome (e.g., reduced latency, improved retention)
- What I learned: 1-2 skills or tradeoffs
- Next quarter focus: 1 priority + why
```

emma (people-ops): Peer feedback ask (short message to send to a peer):
```
Hey {{name}}, can you give 2 quick things I should keep doing and 1 thing I should improve based on our work on {{project}}? One-line each please. Thanks!
```

raj: Love these — can we get a variant for cross-functional goals (eng + product)?

emma (people-ops): Yep. Cross-functional add-on: after the 3-line goal, add a single stakeholder alignment line: 'Owners: Eng - @eng-lead, Product - @prod-lead; success means both OKR metrics met and rollout acceptance by PMs.'

maria: Quick tip for calibration? Managers often write optimistic metrics that are all "increase".

emma (people-ops): Good call. Add at least one quality/regression guard (e.g., "no user-facing regression > 0.5% error rate") and a risk note if the goal touches infra. Also mark which metrics are leading vs lagging.

tyler: Copied into my 1:1 notes. Any short script for managers who need to coach an underperforming goal?

emma (people-ops): Micro-coaching script (for 1:1s):
```
1) Start positive: highlight a clear specific win.
2) Clarify the gap: show the metric (here's baseline vs target).
3) Remove blockers: what resources or scope changes help?
4) Agree on 1 immediate next step and a check-in date.
```
